استفضت (form X)
# اِسْتَفَضْتُ (istafaḍtu) /is.ta.fadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَفَاضَ (istafāḍa)
# اِسْتَفَضْتَ (istafaḍta) /is.ta.fadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَفَاضَ (istafāḍa)
# اِسْتَفَضْتِ (istafaḍti) /is.ta.fadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَفَاضَ (istafāḍa)
